summary: End-to-end verification of day-end PlanPendingNudge at check-out for Tasks QA executive (tasks.qa@example.com). Backend endpoints 200 across /tasks/plan, /tasks/today, /tasks/overview, /tasks/dar-prefill, /todos, /checklists (post-refactor behaviour unchanged). Seeded 2 unfinished plan items via POST /api/tasks/plan/items, admin-toggled the exec into an open check-in, then opened /check-in: plan-pending-nudge rendered ABOVE the DAR textarea (DOM order verified via compareDocumentPosition), listed both items with nudge-done-<id> buttons. Clicking nudge-done-<id> removed that row (2 → 1) AND appended its title into the DAR textarea as '✅ Done: QA_nudge_item_1'. After deleting all plan items, re-opened /check-in: plan-pending-nudge did NOT render while dar-voice-block still rendered — negative case passes. Task Manager regression: all 5 tabs (today/plan/todos/checklists/all) load and switch without errors.
critical_code_review_comments: PlanPendingNudge appends with naive substring check (cur.includes(title)) in SelfCheckIn — fine today, but if two plan items share a title or the user has pre-typed the word, the append is silently skipped. A dedicated set of 'nudge-appended' ids would be more robust.

PlanPendingNudge polls once on mount only; if the user updates the Plan in another tab after opening /check-in, the nudge list is stale until refresh. A lightweight re-fetch on window focus would help.
In SelfCheckIn.jsx:819 the append template uses non-ASCII '✅' + '; ' separators — looks great in the UI but will surface in share-to-WhatsApp payloads. Confirm that's intentional for DAR exports.
test_credentials: tasks.qa@example.com / Tasks@12345 (exec), admin@attendance.app / Admin@12345 (for admin toggle)
seed_data_creation: Created & then deleted plan items QA_nudge_item_1 and QA_nudge_item_2 for the QA exec. Admin-toggled check-in for the exec (session 986bcb4c-...) and cleaned up via DELETE /api/admin/attendance/open-session/{member}. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nudge DOM: [data-testid=plan-pending-nudge] with children [data-testid^=nudge-item-<id>] and [data-testid=nudge-done-<id>]. It only mounts inside the darNeededNow block (status.checked_in && darStatus.required && !done_today). To drive /check-in in tests without geofence hassle, use admin toggle: POST /api/admin/attendance/toggle/{member_id}. Clean up with DELETE /api/admin/attendance/open-session/{member_id}. Plan items added via POST /api/tasks/plan/items {title}. DAR append format is '✅ Done: <title>' first, then '; <title>' for subsequent clicks.
